summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, providing a routine update on total voting rights and capital as of that date. The filing discloses the number of issued ordinary shares (excluding treasury), ordinary shares held in treasury, and two classes of cumulative preference shares, along with total voting rights. This notification is made in compliance with the UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard regulatory disclosure of share capital and voting rights.
